verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent building blocks: search analytics that capture popular searches, fast search-as-you-type in InstantSearch UIs, and custom widgets. A developer could assemble traffic-backed suggestions from these, but no evidence documents a dedicated query-suggestions or autocomplete capability. Missing for 10: documented Query Suggestions index generation from search traffic, an autocomplete UI component or library, a pipeline from analytics into a suggestions index, and independent hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.
